retention_profiles.tenant: Archive by owner-approved offboarding; no cascade deletion of tenant history. Hold/export/purge checklist before deletion.
retention_profiles.identity: Deactivate immediately/revoke sessions; minimize or pseudonymize personal fields after 30 days of approved erasure when no required evidence/hold. Retain nonidentifying references.
retention_profiles.catalogue: Version-controlled reference catalogue; retire entries instead of deleting grants/history.
retention_profiles.sessions: Preauth 10 min; authenticated idle 30 min / absolute 12 h; purge expired/revoked verifier rows after 30 days.
retention_profiles.tokens: Reset 30 min, verification 24 h, invitation 7 days; single-use verifier; purge expired/used token material after 24 h (audit receipt kept).
retention_profiles.assets: Retire/version assets; preserve referenced topology/config metadata for evidence lifespan. No hard delete while referenced.
retention_profiles.observations: 30 days raw pilot default; source records/artifacts referenced by evidence pinned for 2 years after case closure; raw payload may redact to immutable hash/tombstone after approved retention.
retention_profiles.evidence: 2 years after related incident closure, or longer explicit hold; append-only receipts, corrections supersede. No cascade removal of source evidence.
retention_profiles.operations: 2 years after closure; minimize personal content, retain event provenance. Reopened case resets retention clock.
retention_profiles.complaints: Personal descriptions/contact-linked content 1 year after closure; anonymize aggregate records, honor holds and approved erasure.
retention_profiles.attachments: Unattached/quarantine uploads 24 h; clean user photos 90 days after case closure unless explicitly evidence-pinned; delete binaries and retain safe tombstone/digest.
retention_profiles.artifacts: 30 days unreferenced raw captures; evidence pins override to 2 years; truth namespace never public; secure purge by policy.
retention_profiles.simulation: 90 days bulk outputs by default, configs/manifests and curated reproducibility summaries 2 years; holdout truth always restricted.
retention_profiles.audit: 1 year append-only security audit by pilot default; redact accidental personal payloads through controlled auditable procedure.
retention_profiles.idempotency: 7 days tenant business receipts only; 72 h offline drafts covered. No authentication, global self-service or project-contact receipts. No secret bodies or credential fingerprints; expire keys and minimize metadata.
retention_profiles.notifications: In-app messages/delivery metadata 90 days; no full complaint/photo content in external messages.
retention_profiles.events: 7 days replay outbox; business history remains in incident/work-order/audit tables beyond replay retention.
retention_profiles.project_contact: Delete private message/reply email and inbox row after 30 days; no automatic indefinite hold. Rate buckets use daily-rotating HMAC, discarded within 24 h; no raw IP or abuse identifiers in inbox rows.
